name: Brief to Library
about: A deck, photos or notes become Needs; each is matched to the Library or marked missing; the missing ones you pick are made as Objects. In a project you keep them in the project; run in the studio, before any project exists, you pick which to propose to the Library.

input.about: The brief: a deck (PDF), photos or drawings, and any notes. In a project, from its files; in the studio, added when you start the run (kept with the run).

rules.text: Every Need cites its evidence: the file and page (or photo) it came from, or the line of the notes.
Every Need gets one outcome with a reason: matched to a Library Object, an Object to adapt (with the parameters that change), or missing.

Agents never change the Library or a project's model. They write the run's Needs, matches and draft Objects; only the owner's decisions change anything: Keep (in a project) or Propose (in the studio, each Object by its own Propose to Library run and pull request).
A made Object passes the Library check: its 2D symbol and 3D primitive agree at every parameter setting, every parameter has limits and changes something, sizes are whole millimetres.

A made Object is a Project Object: its id is project.<name>@1.0.0. In a project it stays there until the owner asks for it to be proposed; in the studio it reaches the Library only if the owner picks it to propose.
Measure in millimetres. When a size is not given, use a usual size for the kind of thing and say so in the Need's notes.

steps.name: Read
steps.outcome: The brief becomes a list of Needs, each with its evidence.

steps.name: Match
steps.outcome: Every Need is matched to a Library Object, an Object to adapt, or marked missing, with a reason.

steps.name: What to make
steps.question: Which missing Needs are worth making as Objects?

steps.name: Make
steps.outcome: Each picked Need has an Object whose 2D symbol and 3D primitive agree at every parameter setting.

steps.name: Keep
steps.question: Keep these Objects in the project? They are pinned to it, ready to attach to a line, face or point; they stay out of the Library until you ask for them to be proposed. Not right? Write what to do differently and send it back.

steps.name: Propose to the Library
steps.question: Which of these Objects should go to the Library? Each one is proposed by its own Propose to Library run: reviewed when needed, then a pull request you merge.

output.name: Stock report
output.about: Every Need with its evidence, what it matched, and the Objects made: kept in the project, or proposed to the Library.

useWhen: The owner has a brief (a deck, photos, drawings or notes) and wants what it calls for found in the Library, with the missing pieces made as Objects.
